$comment: Referenced-but-undefined dictionary keys that predate the phase-2 check in scripts/locale-check/index.js. Each one is a live bug: `configureTranslator` returns the key path itself when it resolves nothing, so a user hitting this code path sees the literal string 'pages.editSpace.labels.name' where a sentence belongs. They are listed here rather than fixed in the same change that added the check, because they span four packages that deploy on different branches. This file is a ONE-WAY RATCHET: entries may be deleted (by defining the key in every locale for that package), never added — a new miss fails `npm run locales:check`. An entry that starts resolving is reported as a warning telling you to delete it, so the baseline cannot quietly accumulate dead weight.
